instructions.instruction_perforated_pouch: Pack in a laser micro-perforated breathable pouch. Do not seal airtight.

donot.donot_direct_sun: Never leave in direct outdoor sunlight or heat.
donot.donot_wet_pack: Do not pack while food surface is soaking wet.
donot.donot_overstack: Do not stack more than 3 layers deep.
donot.donot_drop: Do not drop or toss crates during loading.
donot.donot_water_spray: Do not spray water directly on cured produce.

refusal.title: PACKAGING WILL NOT SAVE THIS FOOD
refusal.advisory: Cut {commodity_name} kept in heat presents fatal Clostridium botulinum and rapid bacterial soft-rot hazards. Any film sealing this will accelerate deadly anaerobic toxins.
refusal.action_required: ACTION REQUIRED: Do not seal {commodity_name} in plastic. Chill immediately to ≤ 4 °C, sell unsealed within 4 hours, or cook.
refusal.guidance_chill_detail: Place under refrigeration or on crushed ice to arrest bacterial growth.
refusal.guidance_process_headline: Process or cook within 4 to 6 hours
refusal.guidance_process_detail: Boil, fry, dehydrate, or acidify (lemon juice/vinegar) to inactivate enzymes.
refusal.guidance_sell_detail: Keep unsealed in shade and sell to walk-in buyers today.

safety.subtitle: CRITICAL SAFETY INTERLOCK
safety.heading: PACKAGING WILL NOT SAVE THIS {{commodity}}
safety.body_cut_heat: Cut {{commodity}} kept in heat presents fatal Clostridium botulinum and rapid bacterial soft-rot hazards. Any film sealing this will accelerate deadly anaerobic toxins.
safety.action_cut: Do not seal in plastic. Chill immediately to ≤ 4 °C, sell unsealed within 4 hours, or cook.
safety.alt_chill_body: Place under refrigeration or on crushed ice to arrest bacterial growth.
safety.alt_sell_body: {{commodity}} cut this long ago must be consumed or processed today.
safety.alt_dont_seal: Do not seal in any airtight film or bag at room temperature.
safety.alt_future_title: NEXT TIME: DO NOT CUT UNTIL POINT OF SALE
safety.alt_future_body: Whole {{commodity}} lasts days to weeks. Cutting destroys most of that shelf life immediately.
